IMPORTANT DISAMBIGUATION HANDLED: A CollegeDekho page for NIT Kurukshetra referenced a specific, named individual's alleged death by suicide on campus. This claim involves a real, potentially identifiable person and a matter of serious sensitivity. It has been deliberately EXCLUDED from this structured extraction rather than classified as ordinary aspect sentiment — fabricating structured 'evidence' around an unverified claim naming a specific deceased person is not appropriate for a review-sentiment dataset, regardless of the extraction-only framing. If this topic is relevant to your platform's safety/duty-of-care review process, it should be handled through a separate, appropriately careful verification and ethics process, not this pipeline.

Separately, a real news article was found describing a ragging-related disciplinary action at 'Kurukshetra University' — a different institution from NIT Kurukshetra. This was correctly identified as out-of-scope and excluded.

Ragging-related sentiment for NIT Kurukshetra itself is consistently positive/reassuring across all Quora sources found this session, a notable contrast to more mixed patterns seen at other NITs in this batch — this is reported as an observed pattern in available evidence, not as a verified fact about ground-truth campus conditions.

A third-party aggregator (UniversityKart) showed a notably higher aggregate rating (4.5/5, 470 reviews) than Shiksha or Careers360 (both ~4.1/5); this divergence is preserved rather than reconciled, with a caveat about the platform's lesser-known status.
